maria: quick heads-up — onboarding az-13-large-v2. weights dropped at /srv/models/az13/v2/weights.pt but smoke tests show tokenization mismatch and then a container build error.
ajay: can you paste the tokenization error?
maria: the eval shows sequences tokenized differently vs reference run — error: 'UnknownTokenError: token not found' and token ids shift. suspect tokenizer.json vs vocab mismatch.
sophie: did we pin tokenizers/transformers in the model recipe? recent fast-tokenizer changes caused similar breakage last month.
maria: aha, recipe used `transformers==4.31` but our validation CI is on `tokenizers==0.13`. I ran `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').encode('hello'))"` and it returns different ids than the canonical tokenizer.
ajay: for the CUDA/Triton side — when I kicked the test build it failed at the runtime stage: `tritonserver: symbol lookup error: tritonserver: undefined symbol: cudnnCreateWithStream` so looks like cuDNN/CUDA mismatch in the image.
maria: build log excerpt: ```Step 45/52 : RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ... ---> Running in 7f3b2c
tritonserver: error while loading shared libraries: libcuda.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
```
sophie: that usually means base image expected system NVIDIA libs. Which base image in Dockerfile?
maria: `FROM nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:23.09-py3` — our infra standard is `23.05` for CUDA 11.7. mismatch might explain missing kernel variants.
ajay: kernel selection also complaining in logs: `selected kernel: fused_gemm` then later fallback to `matmul` not found. On older cuDNN fused kernels don't exist which causes segfaults. We should force a fallback path in our runtime config until runtime is rebuilt for CUDA12.
sophie: short checklist: 1) Ensure tokenizer.json + vocab match (byte-level vs bpe differences). 2) Add strict transformer/tokenizers version check into model validation. 3) Add model config assertion to ensure `tokenizer_files` align. I can add a validator snippet: ```python
# validate_tokenizer.py
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
import json
with open('tokenizer.json') as f:
  t = Tokenizer.from_str(f.read())
with open('vocab.json') as f:
  v = json.load(f)
assert len(t.get_vocab()) == len(v), 'vocab length mismatch'
```
maria: good. For the runtime fix: two options — (A) change base image to match infra CUDA (23.05) and see if kernels work, or (B) rebuild runtime image with CUDA 12.1 + cuDNN 8.9. I'd prefer B so we keep newer Triton. Thoughts?
ajay: agree with B long-term. Quick patch: add env var `RENDER_FALLBACK_KERNEL=1` in model config to force matmul path for now, so we don't block onboarding. Also, add a CI job that builds container against CUDA11.7 and CUDA12.1 to catch this earlier.
tom: I'll review the PR. please include: Dockerfile change, model validator, and CI matrix. Also add a short note in the onboarding doc about tokenizer/version pinning.
maria: opened PR #4523 (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4523) — includes validator and fallback env, Dockerfile bump plan in description. pinging @tom @ajay for quick review.
dev-deploy-bot: image-build/17820045 started for runtime:tag-az13b-v2. logs: queued -> building.
ajay: one more thing — add `DEBUG_KERNEL=1` env in our smoke test run so the kernel selection path prints which kernels were attempted. will help root-cause.
maria: added `DEBUG_KERNEL=1` to smoke test in the PR. running local smoke now. will update thread when green or if I hit further errors. :eyes:
